questions.question: Count on in quarters from 1 and 2/4 to 3.
Explain why 1/3 is bigger than 1/5.
questions.expected_answer: Both are one piece of the same whole. Thirds cut the whole into 3 equal pieces and fifths cut it into 5 equal pieces, so each third is bigger than each fifth.

questions.question: Order 5/12, 1/2 and 7/12 from smallest to biggest and explain your thinking.
questions.expected_answer: A half of 12 is 6, so 1/2 is the same as 6/12. In twelfths the fractions are 5/12, 6/12 and 7/12, so the order is 5/12, 1/2, 7/12.
